articleTitle: Fighting Insurance Fraud with Hybrid AI/ML Models: Discuss the Potential for Combining Approaches for Improved Insurance Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The emergence of hybrid AI/ML fashions has allowed for advanced fraud detection within the insurance enterprise. Combining a couple of AI/ML methods including supervised and unsupervised studying, deep studying, and herbal language processing, can offer a effective set of tools to hit upon fraudulent claims. Supervised getting to know can discover patterns in claims facts that might indiciate fraud, while unsupervised gaining knowledge of can alert to surprising changes in behavior or outliers in behavior. Deep mastering can analyze enormous quantities of information to discover suspicious claims styles, and herbal language processing can speedy seek massive information units for suspicious keywords. Hybrid AI/ML fashions can help perceive even the most state-of-the-art fraud operations and stumble on anomalies before they grow to be too massive to manipulate. these fashions also can be leveraged to hit upon fraud developments before they become too full-size, making an allowance for early prevention methods. by way of leveraging disparate AI/ML strategies, insurers are higher able to shield themselves from fraudulent conduct and maximize the efficiency of their fraud detection tactics..

articleTitle: Design of Novel Multilevel Inverter for Grid Integrated Renewable Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: A Multi-level inverter through abridged numeral of muscle switches and pulse width modulation technology. This new multi-level inverter is based on a cascaded H-bridge topography. This broadside diminishes total harmonic distortion (THD). This broadsheet put forward a newfangled concept of switching with a reduced number of DC power supplies. This perception comforts diminish the switching effort paralleled to other multi-level inverters. The proposed multi-level inverter with 7-level output is corroborated with simple ohm freight. The put forward notion was endorsed by simulation and a real THD diagram. Multi-level inverter is used in renewable applications to reduce complexity and control.

articleTitle: AromaNet: Integrating Attention Mechanism with Convolutional Neural Network for Olfactory Perception Classification Using EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Today, many people suffer from neurological and psychological issues. Neurological diseases are commonly characterized by a loss of olfactory sensation. Getting proper treatment for these neurologic diseases at an early stage increases the chances of recovery. A patient often is not able to comprehend the loss of olfactory perception in the early stages of neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, etc. In order to identify olfactory sensory loss early, deep learning frameworks can be very useful. The main objective of our study is to build a deep learning-based model for classifying five different aromatic stimuli, i.e., no smell, rose water's smell, perfume's smell, cinnamon's smell, and odonil's smell using the EEG signals of subjects. In this paper, an Attention mechanism-based 1D Convolution Neural Network (CNN) architecture has been introduced. The designed model successfully classified five types of olfactory stimuli using EEG signals with 97.92% accuracy. The study is novel in two respects, i.e., i) appending attention mechanism to the designed 1D CNN model to improve its performance, and ii) analyzing changes occurring in different brain regions in response to different olfactory stimuli.

articleTitle: DeepKidney: Multiclass Classification of Kidney Stones, Cysts, Tumors, and Normal Cases Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Accurately classifying kidney diseases, such as stones, cysts, tumors, and normal cases, is vital in effective diagnosis and treatment planning. A method for multi class classification of kidney conditions using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is proposed in this paper. The main aim is to develop a system, termed DeepKidney, that can accurately classify medical imaging data automatically. This study focuses on the multiclass classification of kidney stones, cysts, tumors, and normal cases using CNNs. We propose a novel approach called DeepKidney, which utilizes CNNs to analyze medical imaging data and extract relevant features for classification. A large and diverse dataset comprising kidney images representing different conditions is used for training the CNN model. DeepKidney aims to achieve high classification accuracy and improve diagnostic outcomes. This approach provides a comprehensive solution for distinguishing between different kidney conditions, aiding in precise diagnoses. DeepKidney's implementation has the potential to increase kidney disease classification's precision and effectiveness, resulting in better patient outcomes and less work for medical professionals.

articleTitle: Advancing Alpha-Thalassemia Carrier Screening for Better Predictions Using Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Thalassemia is a category of inherited blood disorders, becoming a primary health threat due to its increased prevalence worldwide. Through examination and testing of Thalassemia is widely accessible to the people. However, it places a substantial financial burden on the country. Hence, developing an alternate solution for Thalassemia diagnosis is critical. Thalassemia can be either a-thalassemia or β-thalassemia based on the hemoglobin's lack of α or β parts. This research work investigates various Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, namely, Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), XGBoost, Random Forest (RF), and LightGBM. It also suggests an effective ML algorithm for the diagnosis of a-thalassemia. It contains two stages; the first focuses on differentiating individuals between normal and a-thalassemia. The second stage differentiates the two subtypes of a-thalassemia carriers: silent and trait carriers. It is noticed that DT gives a better accuracy of 87% than other models investigated. Furthermore, this work embeds explainable AI techniques to interpret the working of the best-performing ML algorithm to boost the trust in medical practitioners who perform thalassemia diagnosis. Further, the contribution of features towards deciding a-thalassemia is interpreted using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations).

articleTitle: A Literature Survey on Image Fusion Methods for Remote Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The abundance of available image capturing technologies is driving up demand for fusing images in the domain of image processing. Image fusion creates a single composite image by merging pertinent input from several sensors using mathematical algorithms. This method preserves important aspects of the image while enhancing its quality by integrating complementary multi-sensor data into a one image. In applications including robot vision, satellite and aerial imaging, imaging for medical purposes, and robotic or vehicle guiding, it is a crucial pre-processing step. This research discusses the benefits and drawbacks of many state-of-the-art image fusion methodologies at different levels. Along with quality metrics, it also examines spatial and transform-based methodologies and their applicability across several fields. The paper concludes by outlining possible future developments for image fusion in diverse applications.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction Using Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Customer churn prediction is the process of using data and analytics to forecast that customers are likely to stop using a product or service. It helps businesses proactively identify and retain at-risk customers by implementing targeted retention strategies. Business analysts and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) analysts should comprehend the effects behind customer churn and analyze the behaviour trends of existing churn customers from the data. From telecom sector, gaining new consumers is not considered as a smart move because it costs far less to keep existing ones. This approach combines customer segmentation and churn prediction to give telecom operators a comprehensive customer churn analysis. It helps in businesses reduce costs, retain customers through personalized interventions, and gain a competitive edge by leveraging data-driven insights to improve overall profitability and customer satisfaction. Four machine learning (ML) classifiers are employed in the experiments. First, these ML classifiers are used to predict the customer's churn state. To focus on the imbalanced datasets issues, we apply the proposed Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). The best method is Gradient Boosting Classifier, which has achieved an accuracy of 95.13 percent, based on the experimental investigation.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Location for Installation of Line Reactors on Long EHV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Line shunt reactors are used in long EHV transmission lines to maintain the voltage profile at the receiving end of the line and reduces the transient over-voltages generated in the line. The magnitude of transient over-voltages generated are affected by the location of these reactors. This paper investigates the effect of location of line shunt reactor on switching transient over-voltages., generated during EHV Line Energization and Re-Energization., using PSCAD/EMTDC software. A comparison is made between different case scenarios and an optimal location is presented at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: A Review on Donor Selection in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT)
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In the healthcare industry today, machine learning techniques are extensively employed for disease detection, prognosis, and therapy. These methods find use in the domain of Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT), a treatment for hematological malignancies that may prove to be curative. A thorough analysis of the use of machine learning (ML) techniques in the context of HSCT was carried out in this article. Using the databases from IEEE Xplore, Web of Science, PubMed, and Scopus, a systematic review of English papers was carried out. Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), machine learning and artificial intelligence were among the search terms used. This review included a methodical analysis of machine learning methods used in HSCT. The evidence is not strong enough to establish what minimal data variables are needed, or what ML technique is best to utilize in the HCT situation. In recent years, stem cell therapy has become a focus of very promising and progressive scientific research. There are great expectations for the development of treatments. A framework/model will be developed to match the HLA (Human Leukocyte Antigen) between unrelated donor and patient in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT). Stem cell recordings are collected from donors at the Biomedical Research Center and the data are analyzed. Final results will help determine donor eligibility.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Low RCS Vivaldi Antenna for Electronic Warfare Application
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Vivaldi antenna is an ultrawideband high gain antenna extensively used in Electronic Warfare (EW) radar system. When such metallic antenna is mounted on a stealth platform, it is required to have low radar cross section (RCS) besides having a good radiation performance. In this paper, a novel design of Vivaldi antenna is presented which shows reduced structural RCS over the entire operating frequency range (2–18 GHz) along with high gain (>6 dBi) and low VSWR (<2.5). The RCS reduction is achieved by modifying the antenna structure. The metal part of the antenna is removed and additional slots are introduced without disturbing the radiating taper portion. The monostatic/bistatic RCS of Vivaldi antenna for broadside plane wave incidence is presented for different azimuth and elevation cuts. It is shown that the radiation performance of the Vivaldi antenna is well maintained in terms of VSWR and gain with an RCS reduction of 4 dB (average). Such a low-observable end-fire antenna is a preferred choice for stealth platforms.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Phonocardiogram Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Cardiac conditions remain a significant cause of illness and mortality worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for prompt therapies and improved patient outcomes. Phonocardiography, which analyses heart sounds graphically, can assist in identifying various pathologies such as valvar disorders, myocardial infarction, heart murmurs, and abnormal heart rhythms. In this study, we utilised two databases. Dataset 1 has two categories: normal and murmur heart sounds. Dataset 2 has five categories, including one normal and four abnormal types. This report extracts time domain features, frequency domain features, MFCCs, and DWT-based features, which leads to extracting the 77 features in total from phonocardiogram signals. Feature selection techniques were applied and identified the best 21 features out of 77 features with Dataset 1 and the best 14 out of 77 features with Dataset 2. Disease classification uses k-nearest neighbour (KNN), cubic support vector machine (SVM), Kernel SVM, Logistic Regression, and Fine Tree algorithms in MATLAB. The proposed methodology achieved a training accuracy of 94.1% and a testing accuracy of 100% for dataset 1. Similarly, a training accuracy of 98.3% and testing accuracy of 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> for dataset 2. This report demonstrates its potential for clinical applications.

articleTitle: IIOT based Remote Monitoring and Control of Bottle Filling Process Using PLC and Node-Red
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In the industrial bottle-filling process, multiple variables such as temperature, speed, flow, level, and quality must be accurately and consistently regulated. The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is changing the environment in industries such as chemical processing, agriculture, textiles, and food manufacturing. Since the implementation of Industry 4.0, IIOT has become a viable option. By introducing intelligent systems into the industrial sector, this technology alters the relationship between various controllers, Instruments, machinery, and production equipment. It makes use of a Profinet communication network to transfer and manipulate Input and output data from field devices and the PLC S7-1200. This paper aims to develop a remote monitoring and control system for the bottle-filling process using a programmable logic controller (PLC), human-machine interface (HMI), photoelectric sensors, DC motor, solenoid valve, and computers so that its parameters can be monitored and controlled from a central or remote location. This project describes the PLC and Node-Red configuration, as well as the numerous scenarios and use cases created with OPC Unified Architecture (OPC UA). Common protocols used for PLC and HMI connection include Ethernet, Internet Protocol, Modbus, and RS 485. The IIoT system's data will be uploaded to the cloud through OPC UA and Node-Red.

articleTitle: In-Flight Health Monitoring of Pyro Initiator: Resistance Analysis for Actuating Devices and Igniters
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Pyrotechnic initiators play a pivotal role in various applications involving explosive devices, such as launch vehicle staging, missile ignition and separation mechanisms. Due to their single-shot operation, assessing the health of these initiators before operation is crucial. This study focuses on evaluating the health of pyrotechnic devices in-flight by analyzing the resistance of initiator nichrome bridge wires and their isolation from other vehicle avionics. Traditional measurement techniques, often employed for ground applications, are limited in their scope due to non-isolation or ability to handle large number of resistance measurements in real time operations. This paper introduces novel approaches for in-flight health monitoring of pyrotechnic initiator resistance, ensuring safety and mission reliability. The proposed techniques aim to mitigate non-linearities resulting from voltage/current variation and impedance fluctuations in the measurement circuits. Unlike existing methodologies that primarily address pre-flight resistance measurements, this research emphasizes in-flight assessment to prevent catastrophic failures during operation.

articleTitle: Event Labeling Approach for Twitter Datasets Leveraging N-grams, Topics, and Machine Learning Algorithms for Enhanced Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Event detection on social media has emerged as a prominent research area with the potential to unlock valuable information spanning marketing tactics, event tracking, and analysis. However, the effectiveness of machine learning models heavily relies on accurately labeled data, necessitating researchers to undergo time-consuming data labeling processes. This research paper introduces a simple event labeling approach tailored for Twitter datasets, leveraging a combination of n-gram analysis, word frequencies, bilinear interpolations, data distribution visualization, and topic modeling. The algorithm is applied on the ‘Disaster on Social Media’ dataset covering range of disaster events and on events related to Cauvery river from India. The proposed algorithm demonstrates notable performance in labeling tweets. Validation of the results is carried out using five popular ML algorithms, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Bagging, and AdaBoost. The highest accuracy of 82% is achieved with SVM on the benchmark dataset ‘Disaster on Social Media’, highlighting its competency in event detection on multi-domain dataset. Moreover, SVM, Random Forest, and Bagging deliver remarkable accuracies of 97% on Cauvery dataset. These outcomes underscore the efficacy of the proposed methodology in event detection applications. This research contributes significantly to enhancing the comprehension of events expressed in tweets and their subsequent categorization, thus facilitating more efficient event prediction applications.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer and Attention-Based Melanoma Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This study delves into the critical domain of melanoma detection, a life-saving endeavor that hinges on early diagnosis. Melanoma, a deadly form of skin cancer, poses a formidable challenge due to its tendency to remain dormant until advanced stages. Dermoscopic images serve as valuable tools, but distinguishing melanoma from non-melanoma lesions is notoriously complex. This paper explores the potential of Vision Transformers (ViTs), a novel deep learning architecture equipped with self-attention mechanisms, to enhance melanoma classification. We investigate how ViT's attention mechanisms can capture intricate features in dermoscopic images. The study also delves into fine-tuning strategies specific to medical image analysis. Through rigorous experimentation, our ViT-based sys-tem demonstrates promising results and training accuracy of 97% and testing accuracy of 91% highlighting its potential to revolutionize melanoma diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comparison of Order Reduction Techniques for Automatic Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: An automatic voltage regulator is an important operator for voltage profile maintenance with minimized operational cost. To achieve a minimum ISE (integral square error) value, pade approximation technique is applied and performance is also observed by using MATLAB simulation. It is an attempt to search the efficacy of automatic voltage regulator for ROM. This document justified the better performance of conventional pade technique than mixed optimization technique and other relative techniques.

articleTitle: Real-World Applications for PIFuHD: In 3D Digitization of Humans
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This paper presents applications of Multi-Level Pixel-Aligned Implicit Function for High-Resolution 3D Human Digitization (PIFuHD), a novel approach for high-resolution 3D human digitization from single images. The objective is to reconstruct detailed object images. The approach employed in PIFuHD utilizes a multi-level pixel-aligned implicit function, enabling comprehensive analysis of both global context and intricate local details. This methodology aims to achieve detailed and high-resolution 3D reconstructions of clothed individuals from single images, eliminating the need for supplementary post-processing or extra contextual information. The key findings are that the multi-level approach is needed for accurate and precise reconstructions. This paper aims to explore future work based on the recommendation of the authors for PIFuHD, to explore PIFu's versatility extends to computer animation, virtual try-on, medical imaging, and numerous applications in forensic science, Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), offering precision and customization potential across various industries.

articleTitle: Exploring ChatGPT for Email Content Compression and Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In our daily lives, email communication is essential, yet monitoring the voluminous amount of emails can be time-consuming. The goal of email summarizing techniques is to quickly and accurately summarize email content in order to increase productivity and efficiency. In this study, we investigate the use of ChatGPT, a cutting-edge language model, for email synthesis. We offer a fresh strategy to take advantage of ChatGPT's conversational features for summarization while optimizing it on a big dataset of email discussions. Our tests show that ChatGPT-based email summarization outperforms other approaches in terms of performance. The generated summaries provide a clear and succinct summary of the email content that successfully captures the important details. To assess the value and user satisfaction of the summaries produced by ChatGPT, we also perform user studies. According to the findings, ChatGPT-based email summarizing has potential as an efficient and convenient method for controlling email overload. This work demonstrates the potential of conversational language models in tackling the difficulties of email management and advances email summarizing approaches.

articleTitle: Smart Campus Surveillance: Detecting Rule Breakers with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Advancement in Technology have created huge impact on all sectors like Education, Business and Industrial sector. Deep learning algorithms have made these technology to another level in terms of speed, accuracy and efficiency of the data. Deep learning algorithms can be implemented in educational sector to improves its advancement in technology. This project implements Deep Learning for Smart Campus Surveillance which detects rule breakers effectively. Wearing identity card is one of the major rule in campus but avoiding them, it will be considered as rule breaker. There are few dataset available for detecting identity card in campus. For this problem, Dataset of detecting identity cards have been created with 6000 images. Advanced Deep learning algorithms like YOLO (You Only Look Once) for object-detection and Convolutional neural networks(CNN) for facial recognition. Yolov7 detects the identity card with two classes id card wearing and identity card not wearing datasets. It produces 70.6% mAP, 91.3% precision, and78.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> recall.

articleTitle: Quantum Video Classification Leveraging Textual Video Representations
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Quantum video classification is an emerging area of research which unites machine learning and quantum computing principles. This paper describes an approach for quantum video classification which combines video captioning and quantum natural language processing (QNLP) techniques. The proposed approach involves generating captions for videos and using these captions to produce quantum circuits, which are fed as inputs to a classifier running on a quantum simulator. This technique essentially reduces the quantum video classification problem into a quantum text classification problem. The text-based quantum circuits generated for videos also serve the purpose of acting as a new type of dataset for further research on quantum video processing. The proposed quantum video classifier performs well, with an accuracy of 89 percent when trained and tested on a subset of the kinetics dataset.

articleTitle: A Standalone DC Microgrid With Photovoltaics and Power Management Using a Modified Perturb and Observe Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The standalone DC microgrid (SDCMG) can be utilized for various purposes and specific requirements, such as remote areas out of the grid or even places suffering from the unstable grid all their need supporting local of SDCMG, stability voltage, simple control with absent reactive power issues, and utilized to enhance the percentage of green energy penetration to reduce carbon dioxide emissions. For these distinct merits, the SDCMG is an essential option, with more attraction and significant attention nowadays. the paper focused on photovoltaic (PV), and power management to contribute aforementioned benefits, the (PV) solar system is connected through a boost converter to guarantee the system desired output voltage, in addition to the battery storage system (BSS) applied; to regulate charging/discharging. The PV, incorporating the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) and BSS are considered in SDCMG operation. All these features of SDCMG performance were investigated using various irradiance sources by utilizing the perturb and observe (P and O) algorithm technique to achieve the resiliency, and desired stability voltage of the SDCMG and it is verified and validation by using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Role of Machine Learning in Stress Assessment Among Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Stress is a psychological condition that people who are experiencing difficulties in their social and environmental well-being face, and it can cause several health problems. Young individuals experience major changes during this crucial time, and they are expected to succeed in society. It's critical for people to master appropriate stress management techniques to ensure a smooth transition into adulthood. The transition to new settings, lifestyles, and interactions with a variety of people, things, and events occurs during adolescence. In this study, a dataset was utilized to classify 520 Indian individuals' stress levels into three categories: normal, moderate, and severe. Support Vector Machines, KNN, Decision Trees, Naive Bayes and CNN were among the different classification techniques that were taken into consideration. The CNN Algorithm was found to be the most reliable method for categorizing diseases linked to mental stress. The study's main goal is to create a classification model that can correctly classify a variety of samples into distinct levels of psychological discomfort.

articleTitle: Amalgamation of Image Features for Medical Image Classification with Ensemble of Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: COVID 19 disease happened to be one of the most infectious diseases in the 21st century. This widespread disease was very huge where people from almost all parts of the world were victims. This paper presents an idea of amalgamation of various image features for COVID 19 detection and classification. Four most significant statistical image features namely, Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER), Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG), Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) are extracted from the chest X ray images. Contribution of each feature in accurate classification and detection of covid is analyzed initially with classifiers namely Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Decision tree (DT). Simulation results are also obtained to evaluate how ensemble of classifiers comprehend a specific set of features in classification. Through numerous experimental findings, it has been discovered that amalgamation of all four features to categorize the images using ensemble of classifiers yields best results with the classification accuracy of about 97.5%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: As technology's impact on society accelerates, there exists a pervasive lack of awareness among the public regarding these advancements. In India, where agriculture is the primary source of livelihood, the sector is experiencing significant changes in pursuit of sustainable food production. Notably, technology integration, particularly through machine learning, stands out as a transformative force capable of bolstering agricultural efficiency and simplifying the lives of the majority dependent on it. This shift not only enhances productivity but also aligns with the evolving needs and challenges of the modern world, moving towards precision agriculture. This project proposes a comprehensive machine learning-based solution addressing various challenges in the agricultural sector. From predicting soil fertility and total yield production to soil classification, crop recommendation, and species classification, the proposed unified solution covers nine essential functionalities. It offers a one-stop platform for farmers and individuals working in agriculture, leveraging the power of machine learning to provide precise solutions for better decision-making.

articleTitle: AI Methods for Tracking Residents' Emotional Well-Being in a Smart Community
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In light of the increasing population density and intricacy of urban areas globally, there is an escalating need for inventive and effective resolutions. Smart cities are increasingly considered a viable remedy, utilizing modern technology to improve infrastructure, services, and resources. Understanding the core elements of a truly intelligent city involves recognizing the powerful synergy between artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). This fusion of advanced technologies is reshaping urban life, paving the way for a new wave of innovation that empowers cities to evolve into dynamic, responsive entities, prioritizing the well-being of their inhabitants. The ongoing advancements in redefining smart urban living have garnered significant academic interest and discourse. The concept of “Artificial Intelligence” (AI) is increasingly gaining prominence, transcending its origins in science fiction and becoming an integral part of our daily existence. However, the intriguing aspect lies in understanding the implications of this within the broader context of smart cities. The practical s of this technology are frequently more relevant to everyday life than the fictional portrayals of robots in films.

articleTitle: Design & Development of Improved Relay Driver Using PEM for Space Application
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Article details the design, development and realization of an improved relay driver module using plastic encapsulation packaging technique meeting various aerospace-application related requirements. Novel way of implementation of transfer moulding has been used in packaging. Challenge of achieving fit-and-form replacement of existing ASIC-based relay driver with discrete device has been dealt with PEM. Improvement over the relay driver module currently being used in spacecrafts are also presented. Advantages over conventional packaging techniques are provided. Specifications of the module along with materials and processes used in the realisation of the proposed module are detailed. Basic requirements for components to be eligible for use in spacecraft electronics is explained. Preliminary tests carried out over the developed module are discussed. Results are presented giving confidence of the PEM for use in future spacecrafts electronic.

articleTitle: Endometriosis Labelling using Machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Endometriosis is a disease affecting the women's reproductive system. The lesion-like structure that exists in the women's reproductive organ creates an impact on their fertility. The diagnostic approach of endometriosis was performed by a radiologist using scanning procedures. Those procedures predict the occurrence of endometriosis but not the severity of endometriosis. Amidst the radiologist, machine learning techniques play a predominant role to identify the severity of endometriosis. Among all machine learning techniques, the proposed approach uses a support vector machine. Support vector machine is a contemporary technique for predicting clinical-based data. Support vector machine analyzes the influencing factor that incorporates Adnexal mass, Tube blockage, Lesion size, and lesion color for predicting the severity of endometriosis as well as classifying the endometriosis as Ovarian and Deep Infiltrating endometriosis. The execution was performed and trained accuracy obtained was 85%, test accuracy was 84.5% for radius basis function (rbf) kernel and the cross-validation score was 82.5%. Also, the available data was trained using Random Forest and Linear Regression. Among all three models, the Support vector machine outperforms well with hyper parameter as rbf for the given data to classify the endometriosis and identify the severity of endometriosis.

articleTitle: Designing an Automatic Speech Recognition System for the Minor Age Group
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This Research paper presents the practical implementation of an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system for minor age groups in the Punjabi language. Leveraging Deep Neural Network (DNN) techniques, the study focuses on developing and deploying an ASR system tailored to the linguistic needs of children and adolescents. Key aspects covered include data collection, model architecture specific to Punjabi phonetics, incorporation of age-appropriate language models, and the integration of robust content filtering. Insights from real-world user interactions underscore the significance of creating a secure and accessible voice technology environment for young Punjabi speakers, especially in educational and entertainment contexts.

articleTitle: KIKO: A Tools Framework for Industrial Domain-specific Natural Language Processing Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Domain-specific Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks need prepared, ground-truth data. However, practical constraints make this task challenging. Domain engineers, who are the subject matter experts, are required to create high-quality training data. However, their availability is limited because they are busy with their day-to-day high-priority project and organizational tasks. Moreover, the data needed to be annotated to train NLP models may not be available at the outset itself. As the prepared data grows, NLP models should take advantage of the new data and train improved machine learning models. Hence, in this paper, we present KIKO, a domain-specific continuous learning NLP framework that allows domain engineers to perform annotations on one document at a time, and retraining when a large enough collection of documents becomes available. KIKO is made of several tools that pipeline together to process documents from the industrial domain. The pipeline enables parsing, pattern-matching, annotation, training, relationship mining, and continuous learning based retraining of the model by using a weaker form of active learning.

articleTitle: Mathematics-Based Monitoring Of Railways Using Fibre Bragg Grating Temperature Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: As train speeds have grown, safety and ride quality have taken on significant importance in the railway industry. Increasingly serious crashes have occurred as a result of higher speeds, slight damage to railway infrastructure, and unusual interactions between wheel and rail. As a result, in all service situations, the operational and health status of the railroads must be regularly checked. For the rail, wheel, and other components of the railway to work at their best in railway applications, temperature monitoring is essential. In this research, we introduced the geometric configuration of the R-Soft Grating MOD tool, which is used to model Fiber Bragg Gratings (FBGs) as temperature sensors in the context of railway monitoring.

articleTitle: RGW Technology: Pioneering UWB Filters in the Ku & K Band Frequency Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This article introduces a novel design for an ultra-wideband bandpass filter operating in the Ku and K bands utilizing ridge gap waveguide (RGW) technology. The proposed filter features a straightforward structure comprising two parallel metal plates with a periodic arrangement of pins and a ridge. The pins function as artificial magnetic conductors (AMCs), forming an electromagnetic bandgap (EBG) structure that confines the electromagnetic wave to the ridge. The filter is designed by inserting the ridge in the cutoff region of the gap waveguide. The simulated and measured results show that the proposed filter has a wide bandwidth of 12 GHz, an insertion loss of less than 0.11 dB, and a return loss of greater than 15 dB. The filter is also very compact, with a size of only 75 mm × 40.25 mm × 7 mm. The proposed filter is superior to conventional waveguide filters in several ways. The new design is more compact and lightweight, has a wider bandwidth, lower insertion loss, and is easier to fabricate. The RGW technology used in this filter has several advantages over other technologies, such as microstrip and coaxial lines. RGW is a planar technology, which makes it easy to fabricate and integrate with other microwave components. RG W also has lower losses than microstrip and coaxial lines, making it ideal for high-performance microwave applications. The proposed filter is suitable for a variety of Ku/k-band applications, such as satellite communication systems, radar systems, and radIo astronomy systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic Slicing Algorithm for FeatureC++ Programs
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Program slicing is defined as a method required to abstract some statements from a code by analyzing different types of dependency existing in the program. The important application of program slicing is code debugging, different types of testing, software maintenance, program integration, program specialization, and code reuse. Feature-oriented programming(FOP) paradigm is a program design technique where distinct program structures are defined disjointedly and then combined to make a varied types of software products. Feature-Oriented Programming is an overall model for creating programs in different software product lines. The exceptional qualities of feature-oriented programming are mixin layers, classes', and refinements of constructors. This paper offers a new dynamic slicing algorithm for different FeatureC++ programs known as the Feature-oriented Node Marking Unmarking Algorithm (FNMUA). The FNMUA algorithm works on a dependency-based graphical illustration called Feature-oriented Dependence Graph (FoDG). The foremost intention of the proposed algorithm is to compute the FOP's accurate and precise slices.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System for Defending against DoS Attacks in the IoMT Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This paper endeavors to enhance healthcare security in the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) by developing an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) focused on countering Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. Leveraging machine learning algorithms including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), and k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), the IDS is trained on Wireshark-simulated data to identify and mitigate DoS threats. By filling critical gaps in IoMT cybersecurity literature and providing a dataset for IoMT-based DoS attacks, this work fortifies the resilience of IoMT infrastructure, safeguarding health data, healthcare service continuity, and patient safety in our increasingly interconnected healthcare landscape.

articleTitle: Role of Plastic Encapsulant on the RF Performance of the GaN Based HEMT Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This paper presents design, realization and plastic encapsulation of the GaN HEMT die for high power applications. Design & realization of GaN discrete HEMT die based high-power amplifier is carried out to evaluate the performance of the module using selected encapsulant material. The power amplifier is designed at S-band frequencies with 5-watt output power to meet aerospace system requirements. The optimum values of the circuit elements are simulated in standard software. Large signal simulations have showed an output power of 37.4 dBm with 18 dB gain at 2.2 GHz. The simulated input and output return losses are 15 dB and 9 dB respectively. The simulated design is implemented using hybrid microwave integrated circuit (HMIC) approach. The amplifier is realized using thin film processes and packaging techniques. The discrete GaN HEMT die is assembled in a package with Cu-W base to meet reliability requirements of the aerospace system. The realized power amplifier module is characterized initially without encapsulant for small and large signal measurements. The fabricated power amplifier achieved 15 dB small signal gain with 37 dBm output power and 50% PAE across the band 2.1-2.4 GHz. The simulated and measured results of the designed amplifier are comparable. Later plastic encapsulation is performed and module is characterized. GaN HEMT die is encapsulated using dam & fill technology using manual dispensing method. The plastic encapsulation has not degraded the performance of the module and meeting the aerospace system specifications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Earth System Science using Machine Learning and Process Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Machine Learning has emerged as a powerful tool in Earth System Science offering new avenues for data analysis and predictive modeling. This paper deep dive into the application of machine learning techniques to understand and predict air quality a critical aspect of Earth System Science. Process mining techniques are incorporated to explore data patterns and relationships. Our work explores the use of machine learning and process mining techniques in Earth System Science, with a specific focus on air quality assessment. The study involves data collection, preprocessing and the development of machine learning models including Linear Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost and CatBoost to predict Air Quality Index (AQI). Performance evaluation using Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) metrics reveals that XGBoost and CatBoost demonstrate superior predictive accuracy. Process mining techniques are applied to datasets containing city-specific NOx (nitrogen oxides) measurements, resulting in the creation of heuristic process models. This research serves as a foundational exploration of the integration of machine learning models and process mining techniques in Earth System Science with a focus on air quality.

articleTitle: Novel Realization Methodology Employing Thick Film Technique for Band Pass Filter at S-Band on Alumina
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Realization of a 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order S-band microstrip stub band pass filter with short circuited stubs employing Thick Film Technology is presented. This article details filter realized employing Thick Film Technology which has been leveraged to enhance its role in microwave domain. The filter demonstrates performance characteristics, with an insertion loss of 1.17 dB, centered at 2.2 GHz with high rejection exceeding 24 dB. Notably, the filter offers a wide 1.2 GHz bandwidth, making it versatile for S-band applications. Major process highlight presented in this study is the incorporation of vias in the ceramic substrate. These vias are meticulously filled with thick film Au paste for achieving short circuited stubs enhancing the filter's performance. This research underscores the potential of thick film technology at S-band of the realized microstrip BPF exhibiting low loss and sharp skirt.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Action Recognition in High-Resolution Videos using ConvLSTM and LRCN model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The human action recognition problem and its solution is the most demanding nowadays. Using deep learning methods like CNN and RNN increases the effectiveness of systems designed for recognizing human actions. RNNs have been specifically tailored for processing sequential data, while CNNs have traditionally found their use in image analysis. LSTM networks are a subset of RNNs specially trained for data sequence analysis and forecasting which is highly proficient. In our research, we have collected video data of High Definition (HD) from multiple source. We have divided the dataset into 7 categories each categories have at least 30 videos. We have used two of the best deep-learning models here specifically ConvLSTM and LRCN. The ConvLSTM method is similar to LSTM and it incorporates convolutional operations so that data processing and calculations can be carried out simultaneously. On the other hand, LRCN integrates convolutional, recurrent, and LSTM layers into a single architecture. Based on our evaluation, the accuracy of both the ConvLSTM and LRCN models and the LRCN model has given better results with 91% accuracy. To test the performance of our model, we have used human action videos from Youtube in high resolution.

articleTitle: Medicinal Plants Attribute Detection by Deep learning Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The identification of medicinal plant species leads to many benefits to wide range of stakeholders such as, forestry services, taxonomists, doctors, and pharmaceutical labs, organizations that protect endangered species, the government, and the general public. Important plant species are disappearing around the world on a daily basis. Steps include plant identification, restoration, and protection in order to control the phenomenon. Typically, leaves are used to identify plants. Convolutional Neural Network which is the widely used architecture for image base classification motivated us to creating automated methods for classifying various plant species and identify medicinal attributes of the plants. In this paper, using computer vision and machine learning approaches, a fully automated front end based software system has been designed and described for achieving this. Each leaf's length, width, perimeter, area, number of vertices, color, perimeter, and hull area were all just a few of the many features that were taken out. Then, from these properties, a number of derived features were calculated. The native people are expected to get more knowledge about medicinal leaves with the use of this work for the automatic recognition of medicinal leaves. Additionally, it helps taxonomists in the development of more effective methods for identifying species, which will greatly help in the preservation of endangered species. The utilization of various plant traits ranges from the most basic, such as leaf color and form, to the most complicated, such as tissue and cell structure are applied. The results obtained with these analytics gives 98% accuracy in 100 epochs.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study Between External USB and MIPI CSI for Medical Imaging and a Device Driver Implementation for Endoscope Camera Using USB
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: As mobile processor technology is evolving, multitasking has become the matter of a one finger touch. But unfortunately, this technology has not been used on a larger scale in a medical field. So, goal of this paper is to develop an android OS based platform which can interface with various health monitoring devices and to make an entire platform user friendly as much as possible. Initially, a comparative study is established between the USB camera and mobile industry processor interface (MIPI) Camera Serial Interface (CSI) camera in terms of speed, CPU usage, memory usage and max resolution. Later, we implemented a device driver for an external camera i.e. endoscope camera which uses CMOS image sensors. Eragon 820 mobile processor is used for android system development. USB Camera native libraries are used in an android application reducing the development time. Finally, device driver results are demonstrated granting permission of video capturing using external camera.

articleTitle: A Multistage Malware Detection and Classification Model Using Visual Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The development of the Internet and its widespread usage among users has led to an increase in malware activity in recent years. It has become increasingly challenging to identify and categorize malware samples using current anti-malware scanners as they have become capable of evading detection through obfuscation. A simple yet effective multi-stage model based on CNN is proposed for viewing, detecting, and classifying malware. The dataset is generated by combining Microsoft's Malware Classification Challenge dataset and a compilation of benign open-source code files. A visualization technique is proposed to convert different code files to images and the result exhibits an accuracy of 95% for detection and 94% for malware classification.

articleTitle: Crops Analysis And Classification Using Machine Learning Techniques Based on Soil and Environmental Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of modern agriculture, the fusion of technology with traditional methods is essential. This study explores the transformative potential of machine learning in crop classification, leveraging soil and environmental data. The K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model achieved an impressive 97.5% accuracy in pattern recognition, while ensemble models, such as Random Forest, Naïve Bayes, and XGBoost, excelled with a remarkable 99% accuracy, surpassing conventional methods. This research underscores the profound impact of machine learning in advancing agriculture, facilitating precision farming, and addressing global concerns like food security and sustainability. Additionally, the practical implications of this research are significant for farmers, providing them with the means to select crops based on their environmental characteristics, optimizing resource allocation and crop management, and contributing to agricultural sustainability in an era of environmental unpredictability and climate change.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology in Document Authentication: A Comprehensive Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This survey investigates the transformative potential of blockchain technology in document generation and authentication, emphasizing its decentralized and distributed architecture for secure transaction recording and verification across a network of computers. By operating on a consensus mechanism, blockchain ensures transparency and data immutability, countering manipulation through cryptographic techniques like hashing and digital signatures. The survey explores blockchain-based approaches for certificates in education, professional certifications, and legal documentation, examining essential components such as smart contracts, cryptographic hashing, and consensus mechanisms. Platforms like Ethereum and Hyperledger are scrutinized for their strengths and limitations in certificate/document management, addressing challenges in traditional systems and underscoring the potential for heightened security and reliability in document authentication.

articleTitle: IOT Enabled Real Time Data Exchange to Resolve Bottlenecks and Streamline Workflow in Factories
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Using IOT-enabled actual time data exchange can provide a unique benefit while trying to streamline workflow and decrease bottlenecks in production techniques and other complex business operations. By offering the real-time right of entry to operational information, business engineers can quickly perceive system-stage bottlenecks and take corrective movement while stopping broader operational troubles from happening. It may be performed by gaining a massive range of IOT talents consisting of networked sensors and actuators, machine gaining knowledge of, analytics, and automation. In combination with dispensed ledger technology, IOT-enabled real-time records exchange can provide reliable, relaxed, and immediate information transfer among participants within the fee chain, thereby improving efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, leveraging its ease and scalability, IOT generation may create custom answers for manufacturing facility automation and aid emerging technology of the commercial net of things. By enforcing IOT-enabled real-time records change into their workflow, factories can reduce workload, pick out higher productivity metrics, and enhance resource optimization.

articleTitle: The Role of Natural Language Processing in Detecting Insurance Fraud
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Coverage fraud is an illegal hobby that costs the coverage enterprise billions of bucks yearly and can be difficult to detect without the proper equipment. One technology that could assist in detecting fraud is natural language processing (NLP). NLP is a shape of synthetic intelligence (AI) used to research written claims and locate styles or signs that might advise coverage fraud. NLP uses a mixture of machine-gaining knowledge and algorithms to interpret written text and locate positive keywords or phrases that may be associated with fraudulent claims. This data can create regulations and versions to locate suspicious conduct inside the claims. NLP can provide insurers insights into the claims evaluation manner that are impossible using manual strategies. With the power of NLP, insurers can automate the statistics analysis procedure to detect coverage fraud more quickly and correctly than earlier. It can assist in identifying ability fraud cases fast, without difficulty, and as it should be, and save time and money on labor costs related to manually reviewing claims. Using NLP in insurance fraud detection also enables compliance because it offers insurers higher insight into their enterprise procedures, client conduct, and data integrity.NLP can also help offer context to claims records, and with extra sources, insurers can, in addition, beautify the technique of detecting coverage fraud.

articleTitle: EEG-Based Taste Perception Classification Using PCA Enhanced Attention-TLSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: EEG-based taste perception detection offers a unique and valuable insight into how taste perception occurs. These methods find applications in both clinical and research environments. These techniques can be utilized for the diagnosis of different taste-related disorders, such as ageusia, hypogeusia, dysgeusia, etc., and to assess how medical treatments impact taste perception. In humans, a loss of taste sensation may indicate the presence of a neurological disorder. Detecting neurological disorders as early as possible is very important. The essence of this paper is to propose a novel deep learning technique for differentiating six distinct taste perceptions, i.e., no taste, sour, sweet, bitter, salty, and umami, using the Electroencephalography (EEG) signals of the human brain. First, the EEG signals of the participants have been captured meticulously, and subsequently, different features have been extracted from the recorded EEG signals. Then the principal component analysis (PCA) technique has been employed to reduce the dimensionality of the extracted features. An attention module-incorporated TLSTM (tanh-long-short-Term-Memory)-based novel classifier has been designed and trained using the optimal EEG features. The designed classifier model attains an impressive average classification accuracy of 97.16%, coupled with precision and recall rates of 97.5% and 97.1%, respectively.

articleTitle: Transformative Potential of IoT for Developing Smart Agriculture System: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: An innovations science and technology, the Internet of Things (IoT), offers a reliable individual and practicable possibilities to a multitude of enterprises. This includes an interconnected system of individually accessible to programming devices. As a result of the world's expanding population and the consequent requirement for innovative technologies for enhancing agricultural production, IoT could have a profoundly transformational effect on a community. A significant portion of the population in many nations depends on agriculture. Internet of Things (IoT) technologies are now being researched for managing and monitoring agriculture automatically with relatively little human intervention. The different technological tools facets of IoT in agriculture are the main topic of this article. The paper also discusses current advances in IoT towards smart agriculture as well as performs a bibliometric evaluation of Scopus databases to recognize new patterns in the deployment of IoT technologies while tackling issues in agriculture. The paper additionally addresses on the most innovative uses of IoT sensors in agricultural systems. In order to establish a complete smart agriculture environmental systems, the article discusses the future direction of IoT-based production for agriculture as well as the rapidly developing technological paradigms. It emphasizes the open research trend, which could benefit both researchers and practitioners in creating successful IoT-based precision agriculture. The transformation of ineffective agricultural techniques will require the use of IoT-assisted agricultural procedures.

Author Keywords: Transformative Potential of IoT in Agriculture

articleTitle: Fetal Abnormality Detection: Exploring Trends Using Machine Learning and Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Monitoring fetal health and classifying it into different classes is crucial to prevent adverse situations. Healthy fetus leads to healthy new generations. Early detection and treatment of any medical condition is supreme for the well-being and safety of both mother and newborn. This work presents a novel approach to fetal health classification using machine learning models. Three classes—Normal, Suspect, and Pathological—are created by selecting pertinent features from the Cardiotocography (CTG) dataset. Predictive models are created using machine learning (ML) techniques, such as XGBoost, Voting Classifier, Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Logistic Regression (LR). XGBoost model has performed well and attained an accuracy-94%. RF model gave the highest precision and recall for classifying normal and suspect classes. Furthermore, this work also uses Explainable AI (XAI) tool called SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to know/interpret how RF model produces the outcome for test data. ML embedded with XAI supports healthcare providers to trust the model as well as timely intervention of doctors leads to better pregnancy outcomes and maternal-infant health.

articleTitle: Design of Bidirectional Multilevel Converter & T-Type MLI for EV Application Using HRES Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In our daily life, electricity plays a major role in every moment sometimes it become like a part of our life. To provide this electricity in effective manner we require power electronics devices which consist of converters, inverters, controller, etc. This paper represents the current trending power generation with Hybrid solar energy using Solar PV cells and wind power generation with converter modules using various switching operations to get effective results and formation of DC grid results for better utility for both AC and DC loads. The PV and wind systems are using the DC-DC Boost converters since this consist of switch in the design module so to get controlled output from the systems the P&O MPPT controller is provided as a closed loop control systems. Bidirectional multilevel converters are employed in EV vehicle battery management systems, one of the dc loads followed by the grid. This Bidirectional converter is providing three benefits one is to boost the voltage, second is to charge and discharge of the battery as per the requirement and other is to supply input power to the Multilevel Inverter. The inverter which is using in this paper is T -type Multilevel Inverter with NPC. Generally we have so many types of Multilevel inverters with various configurations but compared to all other types T-type MLI is providing various advantages like low switching losses& low conduction losses i.e., indirectly improves efficiency because here we are using less number of switches than other configurations. The capacitors which are used in bidirectional multilevel converter for balancing the voltages and results in the reduction of overall size and weight of the system and also improves the system stability. The proposed configurations is tested and validated using MATLAB/Simulink model.

Author Keywords: Hybrid Solar PV & Wind power generation with P&O MPPT

articleTitle: An Efficient IOT Based System for Monitoring and Prediction of Myocardial Infarction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: An important part of healthcare procedures is patient care. A critical medical condition called myocardial infarction, also referred to as a heart attack, happens once the blood supply to a portion of the heart muscle is cut off, causing tissue could become damaged or even die. Wireless health monitoring systems are immensely used in healthcare facilities and other medical settings, and the medical industry underwent a revolution. Yes, a conceptual framework to security and privacy safeguards is necessary when it comes to the creation of such devices and data as well as their storage and destruction in the environment of medical care and remote health monitoring. The goal of this project is patient health record monitor is stored in IOT and can be retrieved doctors in any emergency situation and proper treatment can be given according to earlier patient records. Therefore, proper treatment is ensured to the patient. Each patient is assigned a unique patient ID. Once the patient's vital signs have been examined using the proposed system's sensors, Machine learning concepts process the data and predict whether it the likelihood of a patient having a heart attack. If the patient has a seizure, then an alert message will be displayed in the developed IoT based web application mobile application and the appropriate doctor receives an SMS with the patient's current status and ID. This could save the patient's life providing the right treatment at the right time.

articleTitle: IWaOA: Resource Aware Scheduling Through Cloud Fog Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In cloud and fog computing, task schedulingplays a role in maximizing the most of available resources and improving overall system efficiency. This work presents an improved form of the Walrus Optimization Algorithm (IWaOA) to handle task scheduling tasks in cloud fog computing (TS in CFC). By modifying the original algorithm in innovative ways, the suggested IWaOAis able to increase convergence and search efficiency by finding a happy medium between exploration and exploitation. Extensive tests using HPC2N real-world cloud fog computing datasets are used to compare IWaOA's performance to that of other popular task scheduling algorithms including WaOA,GAs, and PSOs. The outcomes prove that IWaOA is more effective than conventional methods in terms of task response time, makespan and throughput. The paper further evaluates IWaOA's scalability and robustness under different workloads and network conditions, demonstrating its flexibility and robustness in real-world cloud and fog computing settings. With the potential to increase throughput by 36%, reduce makespantime by 42%, and cut task response time by 26%, the improved Walrus Optimization Algorithm (IWaOA) Presents a favorable method for effectively tackling task scheduling challenges in cloud fog computing environments.

articleTitle: Generating Creative Classical Music by Learning and Combining Existing Styles
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The existing music creation system(s) only prioritise accuracy, that is, producing a sound that closely resembles actual music. Their primary concern is a criterion of legitimacy; creativity and the calibre of the music produced are not given much thought. A system should be able to produce music of a particular calibre, style, or even combinations of the two if it can intelligently model both composers and existing composition styles. As a result, this gives an AI agent some degree of combinational inventiveness. A framework is presented wherein music can be generated by encapsulating the structural styles of diverse composers through the utilisation of a sequence model comprising a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM RNN). Western classical music is our main priority, but we also plan to include other genres. We use the Python module music21 to interpret the MIDI audio files in the dataset. A stream of signals or messages is extracted from the MIDI file and processed sequentially. The generator network and the discriminator network, which help with style-training the generator, are trained with these sequences. The generator network creates musical samples according to the stylistic contributions of different composers after undergoing training to understand the structural patterns of musical notations. The Audio Fingerprinting method is employed to further validate the generated samples.

articleTitle: Enhancement in 6G Intelligent Network Technologies using Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: The foundational principles of emerging wireless networks such as 5G, cognitive radio, and the prospective Internet have already integrated a multitude of prerequisites from the realm of the Internet of Things (IoT). The utilization of 6G technology opens up the possibility of conducting surgeries from a remote location. The rapid and efficient transmission of medical data can be enabled by the substantial data rates, minimal latency, and viability inherent in the 6G cognitive radio network, thereby potentially elevating both the quality of healthcare and its accessibility. The enhancement of Quality of Service (QoS) crucially depends on resolving the intricacies associated with routing Secondary Users (SUs) in a multi-hop fashion. To cater to the decentralized nature of Cognitive Radio Networks (CRN) within the context of a 6G-oriented Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructure, it becomes imperative to formulate solutions for routing SUs that do not hinge on cooperative mechanisms. The present routing protocols predominantly focus on defining an interference range for SUs, aimed at mitigating user interference. However, these limitations primarily consider interference with Primary Users (PUs) and do not align with the fulfillment of regulations set forth by the Federal Communication Commission (FCC). To address these challenges, a proactive method employs non-cooperative reinforcement learning techniques to systematically formulate IoT network routing strategies enhanced by 6G and cognitive radio capabilities. This pursuit introduces a novel Q-learning algorithm that modifies the existing Ad-hoc on-Demand Distance Vector Routing protocol (AODV), enhancing the reconfiguration process.

articleTitle: DeepDrive: Innovations in Distance Detection and Intervehicle Communication Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Over 1.2 million people lost their lives in traffic accidents in 2018, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). This conference paper proposes ground-breaking research that integrates deep learning approaches for object identification and distance estimates utilising onboard sensors with intervehicle communication using Li-Fi (Light Fidelity) technology. Li-Fi integration allows for fast wireless communication between vehicles, while deep learning improves the precision and dependability of object identification and distance calculation, leading to improvements in traffic flow and road safety. Traditional radio frequency-based systems are supplemented by this communication protocol, which offers faster and more secure data transfer between cars. A sensor suite that includes cameras and distance sensors simultaneously documents the area around the vehicle. Our method integrates sensor data with Li-Fi-based intervehicle communication for distance calculation. This study concludes by highlighting an innovative experiment that combines deep learning and Li-Fi inter-vehicle communication to detect a wide range of objects and estimate their distance with great precision. These technologies have been used to show a viable route towards safer and more effective road transport systems, advancing intelligent vehicles and upcoming smart cities.

articleTitle: Data Synchronization Between MongoDB and Elasticsearch Using Monstache in Real-Time Data
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: In database synchronization, data consistency is maintained between two or more databases required. Maintaining data consistency when synchronizing multiple databases poses many challenges and complexities. There are many domains in which data synchronization plays an essential role, including distributed systems, data replication, and multi-site database management. Our main aim is to design and develop a practical solution for achieving real-time data synchronization between MongoDB and Elasticsearch using Monstache. To avoid discrepancies, conflicts, and integrity issues, it is essential to ensure that data the consistent across multiple databases. It is generally a requirement for performing real-time analytics on the data stored in MongoDB. Specifically, our research has two different data sources for our use case: source databases that accept application modifications, and target databases that receive input from source databases. Database synchronization can be achieved using Mongo Connector, Transporter, Mongoosastic, NiFi, and Monstache. The reason to choose Monstache is that it perfectly matched our needs. Our research took into account MongoDB, which serves as the primary database, and Elasticsearch. In addition to using Elasticsearch/Kibana for dashboards, in our work use MongoDB for all transactions and operations. The results of our implementation show that two different databases are synchronized in real-time, achieving efficient and consistent data synchronization.

articleTitle: Unveling Personality Patterns: K-Means Clustering and Dimesion Reduction Analysis for Behavioural Traits Categorization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: A person's personality is made up of features of their behavioral patterns, psychological state, motivation to succeed, and cognition personality traits. Individuals particular personalities do not constitute the sole objective in common personality test results, however, the identity that others who interact with them connect to them. Conventional personality descriptors are frequently referring to the Big Five personality traits. In this study, we performed a partitioning approach such as k-means clustering techniques in personality traits categorization which produces the final calculation of cluster centroids and arranging each point in its appropriate cluster. Our goal was to determine the most significant behavioral variables using data dimension reduction methods such as Principal Component Analysis. The total number of extracted principal component is 51 and the total explained variance ratio in the personality dataset is 24.33%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security in MANET through EAACK: A Novel Approach for Node Detection, Acknowledgment Validation and Routing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: This research proposal introduces EAACK (Enhanced Adaptive Acknowledgement), a novel approach with the primary objective of enhancing security within Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANETs). The inherent security challenges faced by MANETs, including the presence of misbehavior nodes and the occurrence of fabricated acknowledgments, have considerable consequences for both data integrity and the overall efficiency of the network. EAACK takes a proactive stance by leveraging a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) ACK mechanism to swiftly address misbehavior nodes, and it further fortifies data transmission security through the seamless integration of RSA-based encryption techniques. EAACK's efficacy is particularly evident in its successful integration with the EIGRP hybrid protocol, leading to optimization of routing processes and a consequential reduction in overhead. The performance of EAACK is meticulously evaluated through simulations conducted using Network Simulator 2 (NS2), involving a comprehensive comparison with established methods such as TWOACK and Watchdog. The outcome of these simulations underscores EAACK's superiority, boasting higher Packet Delivery Ratio, lower Routing Overhead, and minimized Time Delay. In essence, EAACK transcends its role as a mere security solution; it emerges as a multifaceted network optimizer. By effectively targeting vulnerabilities and harmonizing the intricate aspects of node detection, acknowledgment validation, and routing optimization, EAACK positions itself as a pivotal contributor to establishing a secure and resilient ecosystem for MANETs.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring of Faults in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Communication, Computing and Industry 6.0 (C216)
abstract: Companies supplying electricity deal with a variety of problems due to distribution line defects on a global scale. Many of these organizations are focusing their capital on the study and creation of cutting-edge technology that will improve the steady flow of energy to end customers.
